A '''chamber''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Delaya/Legends|Delaya]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], a [[Memorial service on Delaya|memorial]] was held in the chamber to commemorate the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].<ref name="hostage" />
